prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a large two-storey hall or inn in a snow-buried northern village. Snow-covered steep roof. Dark log walls with snow drifts against them, small warm windows. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 272 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.

Treat the attachment as a STRICT pixel-perfect composition mask, not an aesthetic reference. Keep canvas exactly 272 x 224 ART pixels (the provided guide is enlarged 7x to 1904 x 1568). Fully transparent background in place of ALL magenta, including margins; no magenta visible. Keep roof outer rectangle at art x=2..269, y=28..133, roof/wall horizontal dividing line at y=75; wall facade x=8..263, y=134..223. The roof is viewed from above as a broad rectangular snowy roof surface occupying the ENTIRE upper rectangle; the lower wall is viewed straight on. Preserve exactly the existing seven amber windows and single door: upper windows x=44..59,100..115,154..169,210..225 at y=148..167; lower windows x=44..59,98..113,210..225 at y=192..211. Door x=141..162, y=192..223 touching bottom of frame, a full-size dark brown walk-through door, not a window or decorative plaque. DO NOT shift, resize, cover or add any windows or change the door position. Texture the snow-blanketed roof with clearly defined thick snowy ridges, icy lavender-blue shading, occasional exposed dark slate and overhanging snowy eave, all kept within original roof silhouette except an optional tiny chimney above the roof. Front wall: substantial dark weathered horizontal log courses and restrained timber framing, subtle snow collecting against facade and snowy sill accents, dark door with modest wood plank detailing, amber glowing glass as the only light; cleanly distinguish upper and lower floors with a structural log beam without changing window locations. Classic 3/4 top-down RPG building sprite, premium hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed hard-edged uniform square pixels, on a strict 272x224 pixel grid, nearest-neighbor presentation. Pixel clusters 3–10 pixels across, no antialiasing, blurring, photographic texture, dithering, or soft brushes. Rich earthy 4–6 shade ramps: purple/red saturated shadows, warmer golden highlights. Even neutral overcast illumination from upper left; NO nighttime darkness, cast shadows, glowing light pools, vignette, ground, people, signs, lettering or text. Exactly ONE building, transparent background.
